name: 44149 · Strongsville, OH
findings: ZIP 44149 (Strongsville) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44149 (Strongsville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44149 (Strongsville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
